source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Veterinary Practice
blurb: Practice concern escalation, conflicting follow-up records, and callback audit interpretation.

rounds.title: Veterinary Reception Trainee: Escalate an Unclear Concern
rounds.focus: Acknowledge uncertainty, collect a useful callback, and connect an animal-health concern to the duty clinician.

rounds.title: Veterinary Clinician: Resolve a Conflicting Follow-Up Record
rounds.focus: Reconcile conflicting follow-up messages without treating a booking as an agreed clinical plan.

rounds.title: Senior Veterinary Clinician: Review a Callback Reliability Audit
rounds.focus: Distinguish closed tasks from completed contact and improve the evidence behind a service-quality claim.
